metadata.case_name: CHAN HAU YU v. LI WING KWAI

injuries.description: soft tissue contusion injury to her left elbow/wrist, dorsal aspect of left hand as well as her right shoulder.
injuries.body_part: left elbow/wrist; dorsal aspect of left hand; right shoulder
source: The diagnosiswas soft tissue contusion injury to her left elbow/wrist, dorsal aspect of left hand as well as her right shoulder.

injuries.description: impingement syndrome and tendinosis or partial tear of the supraspinatus tendon.
source: The cause of the persistent pain of her right shoulder was impingement syndrome and tendinosis or partial tear of the supraspinatus tendon.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle or tendon of the rotator cuff of shoulder

injuries.description: ‘contusion’ or ‘sprain’ of the left thumb; ligament injury of the left thumb as considered appropriate by orthopaedic colleagues.
source: The diagnosis should be ‘contusion’ or ‘sprain’ of the left thumb. I consider the diagnosis of ligament injury made by the orthopaedic colleagues of AHNH to be appropriate.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of metacarpophalangeal joint of thumb

manifestations.description: redness over left wrist and face.
increased left elbow pain after the limb was pulled by someone on 26/2/2011.
persistent pain of her right shoulder.
mild degree of decreased efficiency at work due to the residual pain in her left elbow and right shoulder.
tenderness, redness and bruise marks over left hand.
swelling and tenderness of left thumb.
range of movement was decreased (left thumb).

treatments_received: attendance at A&ED (Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital)
herbal medicine and local herbal oil application (self-treatment by Chan)
physiotherapy sessions at Good Health Medical Centre (Li)
treatment by Registered Chinese Medicine Practitioner Mr Chan Chi Fi (Li)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenity arising from contusion/sprain of the left thumb (Chan).
Pain, suffering and loss of amenity arising from soft tissue contusion injuries and right shoulder impingement (Li).
Injury to pride and dignity caused by deliberate public assault (aggravated damages for Li).
